stem:
The diagram shows different types of tectonic plate boundaries.

Which table accurately shows the surface features associated with each tectonic plate boundary?

options.label: A
options.text:
Plate Boundary       Surface Features
1                    Volcanoes and oceanic ridges
2                    Trenches and continental rift valleys

options.label: B
options.text:
Plate Boundary       Surface Features
1                    Oceanic ridges and continental rift valleys
2                    Trenches and volcanoes

options.label: C
options.text:
Plate Boundary       Surface Features
1                    Continental rift valleys and volcanoes
2                    Oceanic ridges and trenches

options.label: D
options.text:
Plate Boundary       Surface Features
1                    Trenches and continental rift valleys
2                    Volcanoes and oceanic ridges

visual_elements: Two diagrams labeled Boundary 1 and Boundary 2 showing tectonic plate boundaries
